The '''Virujansi Uprising''' occurred on [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]] sometime prior to the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. It was dealt with by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and [[Republic Army|Army]].
